encoding: Floats are JSON numbers (Python repr); NaN and infinities are strings. Vectors and matrices as in scripts/ml_golden_common.py. DataFrames: schema and rows sorted by canonical JSON. Model and summary objects: {type, ref} with ref a placeholder: <idN> for an object id (<idN>.summary for a summary), numbered in order of first appearance. Errors: {class, condition, message}. commands: base64 of the MlCommand or MlRelation sent, results: base64 of the MlCommandResult received, both SerializeToString(deterministic=True) after normalization (object ids and uids -> placeholders, plan_id, origin and LocalRelation data cleared, paths -> <path>).
source: apache/spark v4.3.0 pyspark.ml (official pyspark-client 4.3.0, Spark 4.3.0 Connect)
